Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CALF BAND FOR ORTHOPAEDIC CALIPERS AND BRACES 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of calf band for orthopaedic calipers and braces. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. I. 



MS SHEET, T THICK 




L, 




SOO R 



Size 



It 



L, 



1 


210 


30 


1-60 


2 


190 


30 


1-60 


3 


170 


30 


1-25 


4

25 


1-25 



Alt dimensions 111 mUllmetres. 
FIG. I CALF BAND FOR STEEL ORTHOPAEDIC CALIPERS AND BRACES 



3. Material — Mild steel sheet, cold-rolled. 

4. Workmanship and Finisii— The band shall be accurately cut to size shown in Fig. t. It shall be 
reasonably flat and the surfaces shall be free from defects. The cut edges shall be rounded by grinding 
or filing The final bending of the band shall be done to suit the requirements of the individual at the time 
of fitting the brace. 

5. Marking— Each band shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, Initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) Size of the band. 

5.1 ISI Certification Mork/ng — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution. New Delhi L 

6. Packing—* As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 30 Auguic 1971 



(S) March (972. IS)
